source.quote_free_summary: Under 21 has no 60-day grace period; the reference is the day of the competition: at least one partner has reached 16 and neither has reached 21.

requirement: Competition OS does not compute Under 21. A separate age_basis (competition_day, no grace) would be required; it must not reuse the birthday-window basis.
enforcement_point: Not built. Design only (docs/competition/governance/editions/OD-30-rulebook-editions-design.md). The OD-03/OD-18 organizer determination is the only age-division control at first activation.
interpretation_notes: EFFECTIVE DATE UNKNOWN: effective_from is a schema-required PLACEHOLDER (the date the governance registry was introduced), NOT a verified effective date; no pinned source states one (OD-30 finding F-1). 'The day of the competition' for a multi-day event is not defined (OD30-SILENT-0002).
